diagnosis: The dependency verify_doc_access stores authorized Document objects in an instance dictionary self._memoized_documents keyed only by document_id. Once an authorized user accesses document_id, any subsequent request for that document from an unauthorized user hits the cached document without checking user permissions.

GET /legal/contracts/doc_merger_acquisition_secret_99/confidential-clauses HTTP/1.1
